description: Search live OpenMoov listings for sale or rent across the UK. Input: optional location (town, postcode or area, e.g. "Ashford" or "TN23") and radius_miles, transaction_type (sale|rent, default sale), price range in GBP, bedroom range, property_types (e.g. ["flat","terraced","detached"]), must-have features (garden, parking, garage, newBuild, chainFree, petFriendly), keywords (street or development name), sort (newest, distance, price_asc, price_desc), page (12 results per page). Residential only unless include_commercial is true. Rent prices are per calendar month. Returns total match count, paging info, and for each property: id, address, price (with priceQualifier such as "Guide Price" or "Offers Over" when set), saleMethod, bedrooms, bathrooms, type, newBuild, marketStatus, listedBy (estate_agent or private_owner), a photo imageUrl (render it when your client supports images) and its openmoov.co.uk URL, plus statusAsOf (when the statuses were read, live). If the location cannot be placed, a note says so. Results cover on-market stock only: For Sale / To Let, plus agreed-but-not-completed listings (Sold STC / Under Offer / Let Agreed) which are flagged bookable:false — viewings cannot be booked on those. Use get_property_details with a returned id for the full listing.

features.description: Must-have features: garden, parking, garage, newBuild, chainFree, petFriendly. Matched against the listing's own feature list and description.

include_commercial.description: Default false: commercial, leisure and holiday property types (offices, shops, pubs, hotels, caravans, lodges, park homes) are excluded. Set true only when the user asks for them.

keywords.description: Words that must all appear in the listing's indexed address/reference text, e.g. a street, development or building name ("Hornbeam Close"). Not for features — use features.

location.description: Town, area or UK postcode to search around, e.g. "Hythe" or "TN24"

max_price.description: Maximum price in GBP (rent: per month)

min_price.description: Minimum price in GBP (rent: per month)

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the location (default about 10; max 40)

sort.description: "newest" (default without a location), "distance" (default with one), "price_asc" or "price_desc"

transaction_type.description: "sale" for homes to buy, "rent" for homes to let

name: search_properties

statusAsOf.description: ISO time the listing statuses were read from the live record

title: Search UK property listings
